subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the [Job Position] at our company. We would like to inform you that the application review process is currently underway, and we will contact you for further steps if your profile matches our requirements. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to the possibility of working together. Should you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to reach out. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
